name: PEARL Interactive Network (Partner)
desc:
Remote Beneficiary Support Specialist | $17.75/hr plus $5.09/hr toward benefits ($22.84/hr total) | Inbound customer service, no sales expected
Pearl Interactive Network
Industry: Customer Service

What a typical day will look like:
You work from home on a computer with a headset and take calls and emails from beneficiaries who need help or have questions. You look up their information in the system, answer questions, fix problems, update accounts, and write down what happened on every contact. If you cannot solve something, you send it to the right team. You are measured on how long calls take, how well you stick to your schedule, and quality scores, so it is a steady, production-style day with coaching along the way.

Soft Skills
- Clear, friendly phone communication
- Patience and empathy
- Active listening
- Time management and staying on schedule
- Handling feedback and coaching well
wage: $17.75/hr plus $5.09/hr toward Health & Wellness Benefits ($22.84/hr total)
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma (associate or bachelor's degree preferred)
Required Experience: 1+ years of call center experience
Preferred Experience: Customer service or beneficiary support, quality or production driven environment, working with a culturally diverse population

Required Skills: Strong speaking and writing skills, basic computer skills (Microsoft products, internet research, email), moving between several software systems at once, juggling multiple tasks, working independently

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has call center experience and likes helping people over the phone
- Stays calm and kind with upset or confused callers
- Is comfortable with goals like call time, schedule adherence, and quality scores
- Can work a set schedule from a quiet space at home

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no call center experience
- Does not have a quiet, private space at home
- Cannot use a wired Ethernet connection (Wi-Fi only is not allowed)
- Wants a flexible schedule with no set shift or production goals
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email (the posting says skills assessments are required)
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how the prescreening goes, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 resume keywords
- Call center
- Inbound calls
- Customer service
- Beneficiary support
- Documentation
- Database / CRM
- Average handle time
- Schedule adherence
- Quality assurance
- Microsoft Office

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your call center experience and the type of calls you handled.
- How do you stay calm with a caller who is upset or confused?
- This job has goals for call time, schedule, and quality. How do you stay on track with goals?
- PAR: Tell me about a time you solved a problem for a customer. What was the Problem, the Action you took, and the Result?
- PAR: Tell me about a time you got feedback on your work. What was the Problem, the Action you took, and the Result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
- Pay: $17.75/hr plus $5.09/hr toward Health & Wellness Benefits ($22.84/hr total)
- Shift: Mon-Fri, shifts vary between 5:00 AM and 5:00 PM Central
- Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K eligibility, plus professional development and coaching
- Equipment Provided: Yes. Computer, monitor, and headset are provided. You need broadband internet (40 Mbps download, 5 Mbps upload) and an Ethernet cable connection. Wi-Fi only is not allowed.
- Felony Friendly? Case by case. The posting says a background/suitability check is required.
- Drug Test: The posting says drug screening is required.
- Notes: Full-time, W2. You need a private, quiet workspace at home. Posting also says skills assessments are required and that you may need to flex outside normal hours as business needs. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
- Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Beneficiary Support Specialist → Senior Specialist or Quality Reviewer → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor → Operations or Training Manager.
